login.title: Sign in
login.companyInvalid: 3-32 characters: lowercase letters, digits and dashes
login.locked: The account is temporarily locked after failed attempts. Try later.
login.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.intro: Your password is temporary. Choose a new one to continue.
changePassword.same: It must differ from the current one

home.title: Home
home.soon: The screens (warehouses, items, tasks) arrive in the next batches.

entity.codeHint: Latin letters, digits, dashes, up to 32; cannot change after creation
entity.codeInvalid: Invalid code: Latin letters, digits and - _ only, up to 32
entity.name: Name

warehouses.title: Warehouses
warehouses.codeTaken: This code is used by another warehouse
warehouses.locationCodeTaken: This code is used by another location in the warehouse
warehouses.scopeRestricted: Your warehouse scope does not allow this action
warehouses.versionConflict: Someone else changed this record. It was reloaded, try again.
warehouses.deleteMessage: Warehouse {{code}} will be deleted with its {{count}} location(s) and removed from users' scope. This cannot be undone.
warehouses.deleteLocationMessage: Location {{code}} will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

items.title: Items
items.name: Name
items.unitsHint: E.g. "Carton" with factor 12 means a carton = 12 base units. The factor must exceed 1.
items.factorInvalid: The factor is a number greater than 1
items.barcodeTaken: This barcode belongs to another item
items.skuTaken: This item code belongs to another item
items.versionConflict: Someone else changed this item. Reopen it and try again.
items.unitsInvalid: Check the units: no duplicate names and none equal to the base unit
items.deleteMessage: Item "{{name}}" ({{barcode}}) will be removed from lists. This cannot be undone.

import.title: Import items from CSV
import.intro: Upload a CSV to add new items and update existing ones (matched by barcode). Preview first: nothing is written before you apply.
import.fileHint: Up to 10 MB and 20,000 rows. An empty cell keeps the current value.
import.tooBig: The file is larger than 10 MB
import.skipInvalid: Skip invalid rows and write only the valid ones
import.skipInvalidHint: Without it the whole apply is refused if any row is invalid.
import.truncated: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}} errors. Fix these and preview again.
import.fixOrSkip: The file has invalid rows. Fix them or enable "Skip invalid rows".
import.confirmMessage: {{created}} item(s) will be created and {{updated}} updated; {{skipped}} invalid row(s) skipped. This cannot be undone.

row.SKU_TAKEN: The code belongs to another item
row.BASE_UNIT_CONFLICT: The unit clashes with the item's extra units
row.ITEM_NOT_FOUND: No item has this barcode (import the items first)

import.emptyFile: The file is empty or has no data rows
import.missingColumns: Required columns are missing: barcode and name
import.badCsv: The file could not be read as CSV
import.duplicateColumns: A column appears twice in the header
import.invalidRows: The file has invalid rows and nothing was written. Fix or skip them.
import.conflict: Conflicts with a concurrent change. Try again.
import.nothingValid: There are no valid rows to write

tasks.title: Count tasks
tasks.name: Title
tasks.assigneesHint: People who can be assigned in this warehouse
tasks.assigneesDenied: You are not allowed to list people for assignment.
tasks.blindCountHint: Hides the theoretical balance from counters while counting
tasks.aggregateLocationsHint: Compute the difference per item, not per location
tasks.toleranceHint: Lower priority than the item's own tolerance
tasks.startNeedsAssignees: Assign at least one person to be able to start.
tasks.frozenNote: The task has started: its terms are frozen.
tasks.startMessage: The task will start and {{count}} assignee(s) can scan items. Once started its terms are frozen.
tasks.cancelDraftMessage: The draft will be cancelled and cannot be restored.
tasks.cancelRunningMessage: The running task will be cancelled and scanning on it stops. This cannot be undone.
tasks.titleInvalid: A title is required (up to 160 characters)
tasks.versionConflict: Someone else changed this task. It was reloaded, try again.
tasks.notEditable: Only a draft can be edited.
tasks.invalidAssignee: Some assignees are unknown or inactive.
tasks.assigneeOutOfScope: Some assignees cannot access this warehouse.
tasks.noAssignees: Assign at least one person before starting.
tasks.invalidTransition: That transition is not possible in the task's current state.

balances.intro: Upload a CSV of barcode and quantity (in the base unit). An upload replaces the previous snapshot entirely, and it freezes when the task starts.
balances.frozen: The task has started: the snapshot is frozen and cannot be replaced.
balances.blind: This task is a blind count: the theoretical balance is hidden from you.
balances.confirmMessage: This snapshot ({{count}} item(s)) will replace the previous one entirely; {{skipped}} invalid row(s) skipped. This cannot be undone.

scans.title: Scan log
scans.ownOnly: You only see your own records.
scans.voidMessage: The count of barcode {{barcode}} (quantity {{quantity}}) will be voided; the void is recorded as a new record and the original is never edited. It cannot be voided twice.
scans.errNotFound: The record does not exist or is not your count.
scans.errInvalid: Only a count can be voided.
scans.errRecount: The item is now in a recount by another reviewer.
scans.errNotAssigned: You are not assigned to this task.

results.title: Results and variances
results.frozen: Results are frozen: the task is closed and read from the copy saved at close.
results.live: Live results computed from the current counts and the balance snapshot; they change until close.
results.toleranceHint: Applies when neither the item nor the task defines one
results.unknownHint: Counted but not among the items; import them or fix the barcode, then recompute.

close.title: Close audit task
close.impact: Scanning stops and the final result of every item is frozen. Closing cannot be undone.
close.blockedByRecount: {{count}} recount(s) are pending; finish them or drop the item before closing.
close.flaggedWarning: {{count}} item(s) are over tolerance. Closing accepts these variances as they are.
close.acknowledge: I acknowledge the flagged variances and want to close
close.unresolved: Flagged variances remain; acknowledge them to continue.

recount.title: Request recount
recount.scopeItems: A recount of {{count}} selected item(s) will be requested.
recount.scopeFlagged: A recount of all currently flagged items (by the chosen tolerance) will be requested.
recount.hint: The reviewer must be assigned to the task and must not have counted the item before. Their count replaces the earlier one in the result; the first count stays in the log.
recount.invalidAssignee: The reviewer is not assigned to the task.

rejected.ITEM_NOT_IN_TASK: The item is not in the task
rejected.REVIEWER_COUNTED_BEFORE: The reviewer counted this item before
